description: This PHP class defines the Country model in the OpenCart framework. It manages CRUD operations, descriptions, and filtering of country data in the database within the admin localisation module.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Model class for managing country data in the OpenCart admin localisation module, providing methods for CRUD operations, descriptions, filtering, and caching.

methods.name: addCountry
methods.description: Creates a new country record in the database and adds descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editCountry
methods.description: Updates existing country data and descriptions based on country ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the 'status' field of a country record.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Deletes a country record and associated descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a country record along with its description for the current language.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Fetches country data based on the ISO code 2.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Fetches country data based on the ISO code 3.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries based on optional filters such as name, codes, status, and sorting options.

methods.name: getTotalCountries
methods.description: Counts total country records matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCountriesByAddressFormatId
methods.description: Counts countries with a specific address format ID.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a country in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specified country.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description for a specified country and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specified country.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all country descriptions for a specific language.
